scope: The 155 distinct native common-line large-plate layouts at 0.2 mm kerf from the published census. Catalogue horizontal bands on both sheets. Parts crossing either band edge can be discarded. A band can be reused on different stock positions provided the total job inventory is respected.
bounds: Use the smallest vertical span for each four-family inventory. Price all bands using four nonnegative integer family weights, rounding heights down for a necessary capacity test. Check every price inequality independently. Stop if the two sheets together cannot hold the required weighted inventory in this catalogue.
construction_if_open: If the price bound leaves capacity, try one integer sheet assignment using upward-rounded band heights, the original margins and required separation. A feasible assignment must be expanded into original source geometry, passed through the native validator and exported.
scope_of_result: These archived patterns are a restricted construction, independent of the timed acceptance matrix and fixed-core construction.
